annotations.title: Projected voting by mesh block (by suburb)

description:
Projected winning party, runner-up and margin for every microburb (mesh
block) in the suburb at a federal election held May 2026 — a projection,
not an actual vote. The suburb-wide profile is ``/demographics/voting``.
Values only; polygons come from ``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.
